title: MIDAS ValueData
description: A single time-series interval with a price or emissions value.

ValueName.description: Description of the interval (e.g. 'summer on peak', 'winter off peak').

DateStart.description: Date of interval start in UTC (ISO 8601). In v2.0 (2026-06-22) MIDAS normalizes all wire datetimes to UTC across every signal type; the v1.0 PT-on-wire quirk for SGIP GHG and Flex Alert is gone.

DateEnd.description: Date of interval end in UTC (ISO 8601).

DayStart.description: Day type of interval start in local time. On live v2.0 the SGIP GHG (MOER) and Flex Alert (ALRT) signals return an INTEGER (1=Monday … 7=Sunday, 8=Holiday — the upload-format code), confirmed 2026-06-22. v1.0 returned a human-readable string ('Monday'); the electricity-rate wire form in v2.0 is unconfirmed pending utility-data migration. May be null (observed in HistoricalData).

DayEnd.description: Day type of interval end in local time. Same encoding as DayStart — integer on live v2.0 MOER/ALRT, string in v1.0, or null.

TimeStart.description: Time of interval start in UTC. Usually HH:MM:SS but Flex Alert responses use HH:MM.

TimeEnd.description: Time of interval end in UTC. Usually HH:MM:SS but Flex Alert responses use HH:MM.

Value.description: The price or emissions value for this interval. v2.0 (2026-06-22) standardizes the field name as 'Value' (capital V), correcting the v1.0 lowercase 'value' quirk. SGIP GHG values are 1000× larger than v1.0 because the unit changed from kg/kWh to g/kWh CO2.

Unit.description: Unit for the value. SGIP GHG entries report 'g/kWh CO2' in v2.0 (was 'kg/kWh CO2' in v1.0).
